exposure.label: seeded
exposure.note: Sum of rupees_at_stake across every one of the 555 gaps from Sense run sense_20260912_baseline_2aaad73c (as_of 2026-09-12), computed deterministically from the seeded tenant's generated inventory/forecast data with no assumed customer response rate -- this is total exposure across ALL gaps, not just the 424 the planner drafted a play for (127 were triaged out below the Rs 500 threshold, 4 eligible gaps got no valid play). Matches docs/impact_math.md Part 3 'Total exposure' row exactly.

horizon_days.label: synthetic
horizon_days.source: eval/raw/portfolio_2026-09-24.json has no horizon_days field (checked: no key containing 'horizon' anywhere in the file); jobs/sense/forecast.py:31 (HORIZON = 28)
horizon_days.note: The portfolio file itself does not state a horizon. The underlying Sense gap-detection horizon is a 28-day code constant (jobs/sense/forecast.py: HORIZON = 28), used at jobs/sense/gaps.py:126 to build horizon_end=as_of+27d, and gated at jobs/sense/gaps.py:177 for online_sellby_breach/expiry_writeoff/slow_mover/rebalance gaps only -- consistent with docs/DECISIONS.md:177 ('horizon 28'). stockout_risk uses each node's own lead_time_days instead (jobs/sense/gaps.py:204), as do unmet_demand (jobs/sense/gaps.py:275) and assortment_gap (jobs/sense/gaps.py:326), so 'the portfolio's horizon' is not one single number across all 6 gap types that produced exposure this run. Could not find the phrase 'this week alone' in docs/impact_math.md to cross-check.

plays_planned.label: seeded
plays_planned.note: planned.count and len(plays) agree (424). Every play is the deterministic drafter's output for one planner-eligible gap (agents/planner/deterministic.py via jobs/portfolio/run.py), not a model call.

expected_margin_total.label: projected
expected_margin_total.note: Sum of expected_outcome.margin_inr over all 424 planned plays; an expectation under the estimator's default 5% response-rate prior (see default_response_prior below), not a measured outcome -- no play in this portfolio run has been approved or measured.

sales_margin.label: projected
sales_margin.note: Plays whose margin the estimator computes by selling units at some net price (coupon, outlet_markdown, bundle, and the docstring's 'other mechanics' catch-all -- agents/gate/estimator.py:19, code branch agents/gate/estimator.py:242). Mechanics present in this portfolio: bundle (270), coupon (28), outlet_markdown (27), preorder (4), usual_order_addon (3), substitution (1).

writeoff_avoided_net_of_transfer.label: projected
writeoff_avoided_net_of_transfer.note: transfer_plus_nudge plays only (91 of them): the estimator defines this mechanic's margin as waste_avoided_inr minus the per-unit transfer cost (agents/gate/estimator.py:17, code agents/gate/estimator.py:231), not as units sold at a price. transfer_cost_per_unit_inr = 2.0 in config/tenant.demo.toml, identical to the estimator's own DEFAULT_TRANSFER_COST_PER_UNIT = 2.0; the planner wires the tenant value in at agents/planner/tools.py:114, so both sources agree and there is no silent divergence.

margin_sum_check.label: projected
margin_sum_check.source: computed in this script from the two sums above
margin_sum_check.note: sales_margin + writeoff_avoided_net_of_transfer = 206204.98 + 141150.98 = 347355.96, vs. planned.expected_margin_inr = 347355.96 in the portfolio file. Match within Rs 0.01: True.

monthly_cost.label: measured
monthly_cost.note: Measured (usage), list-priced; not a bill -- usage quantities measured over the trailing 30 days, priced at Google's public list rates. Covers: bigquery_query, bigquery_storage, cloud_run, firestore, vertex_ai_gemini (Vertex AI Gemini tokens, BigQuery query bytes billed, BigQuery active storage, Cloud Run vCPU/GiB-seconds, Firestore read/write/delete units). Period: trailing 30 days from 2026-09-23T17:20:51Z for every line except bigquery_storage, which the file itself labels a real point-in-time snapshot, not usage over the window (eval/raw/cost_measurement_2026-09-23.json#/modeled/lines/bigquery_storage/note). Method, in the file's own words: 'modeled_from_measured_usage' -- 'Every quantity above is real and measured for this project over the trailing 30 days (or, for storage, a real point-in-time snapshot). Priced at Google's public list rates, not an actual billing-dollar figure -- excludes any discount, free-tier allowance, or negotiated rate. See PUBLIC_RATES for sources.'. So: the USAGE QUANTITIES (tokens, bytes, vcpu-seconds, read/write units) are measured real telemetry for project amru-509214; the RUPEE TOTAL (total_usd=5.861, total_inr=486.46) is those quantities priced at Google's public list rates checked 2026-09-23 (usd_to_inr=83.0), explicitly NOT an actual billing-dollar figure -- No BigQuery billing export table (gcp_billing_export_v1_* or gcp_billing_export_resource_v1_*) exists in any dataset of project 'amru-509214'. Billing export is configured at the Cloud Billing account level, not the project level; the credentials used here could not be checked for that permission without attempting it, so the Cloud Billing API diagnostics below record what was actually tried. A tier-2 modeled estimate (real measured usage x public list rates) is attempted below instead of leaving this row blank. cost_per_play_inr is None: `taal.plays` has 0 rows with status in (approved, running, measured, unmeasured) in the window, so cost_per_play has no real denominator. Total modeled spend is still reported above.

default_response_prior.label: synthetic
default_response_prior.note: The portfolio file does not carry a named default_alpha/default_beta field. Cross-check: expected_outcome.prior_n (= alpha+beta at estimate time) takes exactly one distinct value across all 424 plays in the portfolio file: [20.0], and expected_outcome.measured_n is [0] for all of them -- i.e. every play was estimated from an unmeasured prior. 20.0 == DEFAULT_ALPHA (=1.0) + DEFAULT_BETA (=19.0) from the code: True. Mean response rate = alpha/(alpha+beta) = 1.0/20.0 = 0.05, matching the estimator's own module docstring ('default alpha=1, beta=19, i.e. 5% with a pseudo-count of 20'). Labelled 'synthetic' here (a weak-by-construction modelling assumption, not measured and not part of the seeded tenant's business data) rather than 'seeded', since it is a code constant the tenant config does not override.
